summary: Verified fix for Expo Router 404 on /my-orders and /merchant-orders. Both routes now render correctly with expected page titles and tab chips. No 'Unmatched Route' fallback text present.

issues: Status tab chips render as very tall vertical bars (~700px height) instead of a compact horizontal tab strip. Likely a flex/height style issue on the tabs container. Not part of routing fix, but worth main agent attention.

action_items: Optional: review the tab-chip styling on my-orders.tsx and merchant-orders.tsx — chips currently expand vertically to fill remaining space instead of sitting in a horizontal tab bar.
critical_code_review_comments: Registering each new route in _layout.tsx Stack.Screen is easy to forget. Consider using file-based auto-registration or adding a lint/test to ensure every app/*.tsx page has a corresponding Stack.Screen entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing fix verified on mobile viewport (390x844) against preview URL. /my-orders shows title 'My Orders' with tabs Placed/Accepted/Ready/Completed and 'Loading your orders...'; /merchant-orders shows 'Customer Orders' with tabs New/Accepted/Ready/Completed and 'Loading orders...'. Neither shows Unmatched Route fallback. Note the request mentioned 'Pickup Ready' but the actual label rendered is 'Ready' — appears intentional in code.
rca of the issue: Expo Router in this project uses explicit <Stack.Screen name=...> declarations in app/_layout.tsx. Newly added screens my-orders.tsx and merchant-orders.tsx were not listed, so the router fell back to the Unmatched Route (404) screen. Fix: added Stack.Screen entries for both names. Verified by direct navigation to both URLs on the external preview host.
